title: Yeti sacrificed to Kali
description: In the Ice Caves, the player stomps a yeti beside Kali's altar, picks it up stunned and drops it on the altar. It lies still there for a moment, then bursts into flame: Kali accepts the sacrifice, and she seems happy with him.
